elements.label: EXAMPLE 9.3
elements.title: Python code to generate a histogram for monthly sales data
elements.details: Python code snippet importing matplotlib.pyplot as plt and matplotlib.ticker as ticker; defines a function format_ticks to format ticks with commas as thousands separators; defines a sales data list with 30 sales amounts in U.S. dollars.
elements.summary: This code example demonstrates how to use Python's Matplotlib library to create a histogram for a given dataset of monthly sales amounts.
